topic: Specifications of works, materials, and standard construction details

questions.q: 76. The capacity of a flushing cistern is normally
questions.explain: Standard domestic low-level flushing cisterns have a capacity of 12-15 liters.

questions.q: 92. What is the minimum period for which the lime concrete in foundation be left wet without the construction of masonry over it?
questions.explain: Lime concrete requires a curing period of at least 7 days before building upon it.

questions.q: 115. The rate of an item of work depends
questions.explain: Rates are influenced by the quality of materials, the specific task instructions (specifications), and the construction techniques used.

questions.q: 116. The main purpose of specification is
questions.explain: Specifications serve to define work nature, material quality, and assist in accurate costing and quantity surveying.

questions.q: 117. *Specification includes
questions.explain: A complete specification details the quality of materials, the specific type of work, and the step-by-step methodology.

questions.q: 118. Which one information is found through specification?
questions.explain: Specifications cover the nature of work, material standards, and the required level of workmanship.

questions.q: 119. *Which one information is not found in specification?
questions.explain: While specifications describe quality and method, dimensions are primarily found in architectural and engineering drawings, not the written specification.

questions.q: 123. In specification of earth work in foundation trenches, drains etc. lift ordinarily specified is
questions.explain: The standard unit of vertical distance (lift) for earthwork in excavations is 1.5 meters.

questions.q: 124. In specification of earth work in foundation trenches, drains etc. lead specified is (IS code)
questions.explain: The standard unit of horizontal distance (lead) for disposal of earth is 30 meters according to IS codes.

questions.q: 143. *The number of corrugations in a galvanized corrugated sheet is usually
questions.explain: Standard CGI (Galvanized Corrugated Iron) sheets used in roofing commonly have 10 corrugations.

questions.q: 144. The number of corrugations in a asbestos cement sheet is usually
questions.explain: Standard Asbestos Cement (AC) sheets typically feature 7 corrugations.

questions.q: 145. The standard width of galvanized iron sheet is
questions.explain: The standard commercial width for GI sheets is 36 inches.

questions.q: 146. *The standard width of asbestos cement corrugated sheet is
questions.explain: AC corrugated sheets are standardized at a width of 1.05 meters.

questions.q: 147. Minimum side lap required for asbestos cement sheets is
questions.explain: For weatherproofing, AC sheets must overlap by at least 15 cm on the sides.

questions.q: 148. End lap provided in asbestos cements is equal to
questions.explain: The vertical overlap (end lap) between AC sheets should be 15 cm.

questions.q: 149. The minimum space left from property line (In Kathmandu valley) for the provision of window/door is
questions.explain: Building bylaws in Kathmandu Valley require a 5-foot setback from the property line if windows or doors are to be installed.

questions.q: 150. Minimum size of pipe connected in septic tank is
questions.explain: To prevent clogging of waste, a minimum 100 mm diameter pipe is required for septic tank connections.

questions.q: 152. The building material brick
options: absorb equal heat as the stone
questions.explain: Bricks generally have a higher thermal capacity and lower thermal conductivity compared to many dense stones, causing them to absorb and retain more heat.

questions.q: 156. Specifications for the hold fasts are given in terms of
questions.explain: Hold fasts are typically made of mild steel flats and are measured by weight (kilograms or quintals) in detailed estimates.

questions.q: 159. The thickness of 25 guage sheet is
questions.explain: 25 Gauge (SWG) steel is approximately 0.508 mm thick, which is significantly less than 1mm.

questions.q: 160. The concealed faces of the frames of doors and windows are painted with
options: two coats of same enamel paint which is applied for the rest of the frame
questions.explain: Faces of timber frames in contact with masonry are coated with coal tar or a wood preservative to prevent moisture penetration and decay.

questions.q: 162. Which of the following is not a common size of reinforcement bars?
questions.explain: While 32mm exists, in standard residential and common civil works, 8, 10, 12, 16, 20, and 25mm are the most 'common' sizes used, whereas 32mm is reserved for heavy industrial/bridge works.

questions.q: 183. The essential requirements to prepare a good estimate are
options: a full dimensioned drawing to scale
questions.explain: An accurate estimate requires drawings for dimensions, specs for quality, and rates for pricing.

questions.q: 184. A layer of dry bricks put below the foundation concrete, in the case of soft soils, is called
questions.explain: Brick flat soling or stone soling is used to provide a firm base and distribute loads over soft soil before pouring concrete.

questions.q: 199. The document supplementing the drawing to furnish information that are not covered in drawings and explaining the workmanship, and method of working is
questions.explain: Specifications describe the quality of materials and the standard of workmanship required, which drawings alone cannot convey.

questions.q: 223. Specification of works is required only when the work is carried by:
questions.explain: Specifications are essential for any mode of execution to ensure quality and standard of work.

questions.q: 228. An explicit set of requirements to be satisfied by a material, product or service is called a set of:
questions.explain: Specifications detail the materials, workmanship, and standards required for the project.

questions.q: 238. In corrugated Galvanized Iron sheets, the pitch of the corrugation is measured, usually as
questions.explain: The standard pitch for CGI sheets used in roofing is commonly 75mm.

questions.q: 242. The two type of specification commonly are
questions.explain: Specifications usually focus on the materials to be used and the items of work to be performed.

questions.q: 244. Which of the following is a type of contract specification:
questions.explain: Technical specifications are the core part of construction contracts, detailing how the work is to be done.

questions.q: 250. Norms are used to:
questions.explain: Norms provide the standard quantity of labor and materials required for a unit of work, essential for rate analysis.
